name: Omabot
author: Neil Patel
description: Your Grok Bot roster in the bar: every bot drawn as its own avatar, with an expression for its state and one keypress to the app.

barWidget.description: Bots waiting on you appear in the bar as their own avatars - the shape and colour they have in Grok Bot - and the panel lists every bot by channel with its last message.

schema.label: What sits beside the logo
schema.description: The Grok Bot logo is always shown. To its right: avatars = the bots waiting on you, as themselves; count = how many are waiting; none = the logo alone.

schema.label: Panel order
schema.description: attention = bots waiting on you first, longest wait at the top, then a rule and everyone else by recency; channels = the sections you set up in Grok Bot; flat = purely by last message.

schema.label: Group the panel by channel
schema.description: Use the channels (sidebar sections) you set up in Grok Bot. Off sorts every bot together, most urgent first.

schema.label: Most avatars to show in the bar
